newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian overnight rates end higher at 20.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian overnight rates end higher at 20.25 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed higher on Tuesday in routine trading on the first day of the banks' new two-week reserve period, traders said.
Overnight rates traded at around the one week reverse repo level of 20.25 percent, compared to Monday's close of 18.00 percent, and were expected to stay at around that level.
"Rates moved between 20 and 20 1/.2 percent and settled at the one week reverse repo rate of 20 1/4," said Gabor Liener of Unicbank. "I expect rates to stay at that level."
Traders said the rates had risen as the period of highest liquidity at the end of the reserve period, when banks have usually topped up their reserves already, was now passed.
